hook_text: When the taps run dry, a big truck carrying thousands of litres of water can be the most welcome sight in town.
clip_script: Makhanda, in the Eastern Cape, during a long drought. The taps in the street are dry. Then a loud hooter: the water truck is here! People hurry out with buckets, drums and containers and line up. The driver connects a thick hose, and clean water gushes into a big plastic tank on a stand and into the waiting containers. In half an hour, the truck is empty and drives off to the next street. Water on wheels.
visual_style: Whiteboard water tanker truck with a big round tank, a hose to a community tank on a stand, a queue of people with containers, and a calendar showing delivery days.
mood: Relieved and grateful, but thinking ahead.
pacing: Quiet dry street, burst of activity when the truck arrives, then calm as it leaves.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find out who to call in your area if the water stops.
